parameters.query: INSERT INTO contatos (telefone, ticket_id) VALUES ($1::text, $2::bigint) ON CONFLICT (telefone) DO UPDATE SET atualizado_em = now(), ticket_id = COALESCE($2::bigint, contatos.ticket_id) RETURNING id AS contato_id

WITH marca AS (INSERT INTO marcas_conteudo (contato_id, hash_conteudo) SELECT $1::bigint, sha256(convert_to($4::text, 'UTF8')) WHERE $2::text IS NULL AND $3::text = 'texto' ON CONFLICT (contato_id, hash_conteudo) DO UPDATE SET visto_em = now() WHERE marcas_conteudo.visto_em < now() - make_interval(secs => $6::int) RETURNING 1), ins AS (INSERT INTO mensagens (contato_id, mensagem_id_canal, direcao, tipo, conteudo, midia_url, midia_mime, midia_segundos, midia_bytes) SELECT $1::bigint, $2::text, 'entrada', $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::bigint WHERE $3::text <> 'texto' OR $2::text IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marca) ON CONFLICT (mensagem_id_canal) DO NOTHING RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS id, $1::bigint AS contato_id

SELECT (extract(epoch FROM min(criado_em)) * 1000)::bigint AS mais_antiga_ms FROM mensagens WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND direcao = 'entrada' AND processada_em IS NULL AND (turno_id IS NULL OR turno_em < now() - interval '{{BV:lock.ttl_s}} seconds')

parameters.query: WITH t AS (SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS u), alvo AS (SELECT id FROM mensagens WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND direcao = 'entrada' AND processada_em IS NULL AND (turno_id IS NULL OR turno_em < now() - interval '{{BV:lock.ttl_s}} seconds') ORDER BY criado_em, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE mensagens m SET turno_id = t.u, turno_em = now() FROM alvo, t WHERE m.id = alvo.id RETURNING m.id, m.tipo, m.conteudo, m.midia_url, m.midia_mime, m.midia_segundos, m.midia_bytes, m.criado_em, m.turno_id
WITH u AS (UPDATE mensagens SET processada_em = now() WHERE turno_id = $1::uuid AND processada_em IS NULL RETURNING id) SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM u
WITH u AS (UPDATE mensagens SET turno_id = NULL, turno_em = NULL WHERE turno_id = $1::uuid AND processada_em IS NULL RETURNING id) SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM u

parameters.query: SELECT $1::bigint AS contato_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM mensagens_agendadas WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND tipo = 'confirmacao' AND situacao = 'enviada' AND resposta IS NULL AND motivo IS NULL AND inicio > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS abertas, (SELECT count(*) FROM mensagens_agendadas WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND tipo = 'confirmacao' AND resposta IS NOT NULL AND respondida_em > now() - make_interval(secs => $2::int)) AS recentes, (SELECT count(*) FROM propostas WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND estado = 'pendente' AND criada_em > now() - make_interval(mins => $3::int)) AS propostas, COALESCE((SELECT tipo = 'lista' AND mensagem_id_canal LIKE 'agendada-%' FROM mensagens WHERE contato_id = $1::bigint AND direcao = 'saida' ORDER BY criado_em DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS ultima_lista
